metadata.description: Pavel's personal Claude Code kit — deep research, vibecoding test discipline, swarm orchestration, external second opinions, and the Troika working mode with its decision log, blind judge, and session-rules hooks. Install individually.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Deep research engine for market analysis, product strategy, competitive intelligence and thesis stress testing. Turns the agent into a skeptical investor and systems thinker rather than a summarizer.

plugins.name: vibecoding
plugins.description: Testing methodology and bug prevention for UI features built with AI. Enforces the seed-first, content-not-structure workflow that prevents green test suites over broken UIs.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Orchestrated multi-agent implementation from a phased plan. Spawns worker agents in isolated git worktrees per phase, hands review to a fresh-context blind judge, retries up to three times, and stops at an open PR for a human merge seat.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Get a second opinion from OpenAI (Codex), Google (Gemini) or Anthropic (Claude Code) CLIs. Single provider or multi-model consensus for architecture decisions and security review.

plugins.name: troika-mode-1707
plugins.description: The Troika working mode: Kentaurs (one human plus their agents), at most three per epic, the epic issue as the room, derived status from draft PRs, shared gates, mode-routing intake and model policy. Versioned, with an append-only lessons ledger.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Append-only decision records in the host repo: PRD-D, ARCH-D, JUDGE-V, GATE-X, MODEL-R and TEST-D. Ships a pytest guard template that fails CI when an existing decision record is modified or deleted.

plugins.name: blind-judge
plugins.description: Fresh-context judging protocol: deterministic oracles run first, the judge never sees the implementer's transcript or authorship, one isolated judge per rubric dimension, and a consolidator that fails loudly on missing reports.

plugins.name: session-rules
plugins.description: Hooks that surface the host repo's decision records into the session: a SessionStart digest of the latest records and a UserPromptSubmit re-emit of a short decisions/RULES.md. Silent no-op in repos without a decisions directory.
